name: app-round-icon-nav-bar-with-lime-active-state
title: Row of four round nav buttons with the settings one filled lime
whatItIs: A wide white strip with four circular buttons in light grey with black icons (home, car, clock, settings), the last in lime, above a faint grey glow.
whatItMeans: Simple and tactile; a single lime circle marks the active tab.
techniques: Use separate circles instead of a bar.
Mark the active state with one lime fill.
Show the component alone on white.

vocabulary.definition: Selected state shown by a colour fill.
